say.speaker: partner
say.text: Bzzzt-ow!! My feathers are tingling so hard I can barely lift my feet!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: That is a super-effective hit! Electric strikes deal double damage to Water types like you, {partner}, so always check typing before you trade blows.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Worse yet, Nuzzle left you Paralyzed, cutting your Speed and Mov! Burns, Poison, Sleep, and Freeze can cripple a squad just as fast.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Catch this Paralyze Heal! Select {partner} and use your Item to shake off the static, then work together to defeat Starly, Caterpie, and Pawmi!
